hero.description: At Deep Roots, privacy is not a feature — it's a right.

commitment.title: Our Commitment to You
commitment.description: We don't just talk about decentralization — we build it into how we collect, store, and protect your data.

dont.title: What We Don't Do
dont.store: We don't store personal information without your consent
dont.thirdParty: We don't allow third-party tracking on our core products

do.store: Store only what's needed — and only if you allow it
do.encrypt: Use encrypted systems across all platforms
do.anonymous: Offer anonymous or wallet-based access wherever possible
do.manage: Let you manage your own data through decentralized identity (DID) tools
do.ai: Use AI responsibly — with transparency, not intrusion

data.title: How Your Data Is Handled
data.openSource: Open-source audits and smart contract transparency
data.did: Future DID and self-sovereign profile integration

philosophy.title: No Secrets. No Surveillance.
philosophy.description: We're building DeWorld — a digital space where you're not the product. Your privacy is baked into the roots of the platform, not added later.
